The build and the UI interaction part of the scenario passed on Unity 2022.3.62f3, but the visual evidence failed: neither Game capture shows the UI. Both PNGs show only the skybox and are byte-identical, so they don't prove anything about the screen. There were also two tool problems along the way, listed below. All commands went to 127.0.0.1:6518 and the Editor is back in Edit Mode.

**Assets created**
- Scene: `Assets/Scenes/Generated/E2E/ToolkitDemo.unity`, containing a `ToolkitDemo` object with a `UIDocument` and the `ToolkitDemoBinding` component
- `Assets/UI/ToolkitDemo/Screen.uxml`, `Screen.uss`, `Theme.tss`, `Panel.asset` (the PanelSettings)
- `Assets/Scripts/ToolkitDemoBinding.cs`

I wrote the source files and created the PanelSettings and UIDocument with `editor eval`, the script with `create_csharp_file`, and attached the component with `add_component`. No scene or asset YAML was edited. Unity 2022.3 didn't assign a default theme, so `Theme.tss` (which imports Unity's default theme) is assigned to the panel. The script compiled with 0 errors. After saving and reloading, the scene still had the document, panel, layout file, theme and binding, and none of that changed after Play. `Issue366.unity` was not changed.

**UI automation results** (all read with `get_ui_element_state`)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Find controls | `uitk:/ToolkitDemo#submit`, `#player-name` and `#status` found; panel ready at 1280×720 |
| Before input | status = `Welcome`, player-name = `""` |
| Set player-name to `Ada` | success; reads back `Ada`; status still `Welcome` |
| Click `#submit` | success |
| After click | **status = `Hello, Ada!`** ✅ |

The console showed no errors from the binding or the UI. The only Error entries are the bridge's "Dropped 1 queued command" messages, logged when requests were cut off during startup and the script reload.

**Failures**
1. **The Game captures don't include the UI.** `capture_screenshot` with `captureMode:"game"`, `includeUI:true` and `osFallback:false` rendered from Main Camera only, which leaves out the UI Toolkit layer. `game-initial.png` and `game-result.png` are 1280×720 skybox images with the same checksum. I tried the bridge's Game window capture and it returned "Direct window capture is not fully supported". I didn't use OS screenshots or any other workaround. This needs a separate Issue.
2. **`create_csharp_file` crashed the CLI** with "Cannot start a runtime from within a runtime" (`src/tooling/local_tools.rs:842`) when called with `refresh`/`waitForCompile` set to true. The file had already been written, and it matches the source except for a UTF-8 byte-order mark the tool added. I then refreshed with `refresh_assets` and polled `get_compilation_state` until it finished. This also needs an Issue.
3. **The bridge didn't respond at first.** Pings timed out for about a minute after the project loaded, even though the correct Editor owned the port. It answered on a later retry without me changing anything.

- `game-initial.png` and `game-result.png` (skybox only, as above)
